remarks: Just listed! Stunning sunlit 3 bedroom North Stamford Contemporary home quietly nestled on 1.34 acres on a private lane boasts open floor plan with dramatic great room with fireplace, vaulted ceiling, sliders and walls of windows with inviting deck to enjoy nature year round, dining room, updated granite eat in kitchen, family room with fireplace, Primary bedroom with walk in closet and spacious master bath with whirlpool tub and stall shower, 2 additional bedrooms.Laundry conveniently located on upper level. Zoned heat and c/a, attached 2 car garage, full basement, new roof, whole house generator, etc. Freshly painted interior. Ready to move into and enjoy! Close to Stamford Museum and Nature Preserve, Arboretum and a short drive to shopping, restaurants, Merritt Parkway, etc. Beach rights on Long Island Sound. 2 municipal golf courses. Less than 1 hour from NYC!
